text:
elena_cs: Customer ACMECorp on Dedicated reported a large traffic spike ~09:12 UTC, started seeing 429s and high tail latency. They say autoscale 'didn't kick' for ~3m. They want root cause and mitigation now. Attaching their repro steps below.
ryan_oncall: ack. Can you paste the customer request sample + approximate rps pattern? Also which dedicated pool (eu-west-1-prod-dedicated-42)?
elena_cs: Pool is eu-west-1-prod-dedicated-42. Repro: they replayed ~2000 requests over 30s, then sustained 400 rps for ~2m. Sample curl they used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-opt-8bit","input":"summarize..."}'
```
They captured the client-side: many 429s with body `{"error":"capacity_unavailable","detail":"min_replicas_floor"}` and some `attach_timeout` traces.
ryan_oncall: thanks. I'm tailing platform metrics now (autoscaler and attach controller). Early signs: autoscaler issued scaleUp but attach controller logged retries. Pasting relevant controller log snippets: 
```
[09:12:34] attach-controller: Attach request for pod pod-123 failed: iam-pull-rate-limited, retrying
[09:13:02] attach-controller: pod pod-124 attach timeout after 20s, marking Unready
[09:14:00] autoscaler: desiredReplicas=30 current=6 minReplicas=6 maxReplicas=100 reason=cpu+qps
```
sanjay_infra: adding context — that pool had minReplicas pinned at 6 by policy earlier for cost reasons. When the attach-controller sees image pull/IAM auth backoff it effectively serializes pod readiness which delays scaleout. Also saw node group hitting CPU spike on a couple hosts (possible noisy tenant).
tau_runtime: fwiw runtime is optimized for fast warm starts but attach + imagepull is the gate here. Two probable contributors: 1) minReplicas floor too low for this burst pattern (cold spin required), 2) attach/imagepull backoffs due to concurrent IAM/token refresh rate limits and registry throttle -> handshakes stall.
elena_cs: customer also mentioned they recently rotated service account keys. Could that cause auth backoff?
sanjay_infra: yes, if rotation triggered many pods to pull updated credentials simultaneously, we can hit IAM token reuse / rate limits. I see repeated `IAM quota exceeded` in audit logs around 09:12.
ryan_oncall: mitigation steps to propose now: 1) temporarily raise minReplicas to 20 for their pool to soak the spike; 2) enable warm-burst reserved capacity for 5m; 3) if attach/imagepull errors persist, escalate image registry quota with infra.
tau_runtime: quick command to change minReplicas: 
```
# internal admin CLI
rwctl pools update --pool eu-west-1-prod-dedicated-42 --min-replicas 20 --reason "CS emergency for ACMECorp"
```
If we can't raise quickly, a faster surface mitigation is to add a canary fallback in routing to a compatible hosted-backed model for 5m so customer traffic doesn't see 429s.
elena_cs: customer ok with temporary fallback while we fix infra. They asked for repro steps we used to validate.
ryan_oncall: repro steps I ran: 1) replayed customer trace via our traffic generator at same qps pattern; 2) watched `attach-controller` logs and `kube events` for imagepull/iam errors; 3) validated autoscaler desiredReplicas increments but pods stuck in ContainerCreating. Command used: 
```
kg events -n dedicated eu-west-1-prod-dedicated-42 | grep -E "Failed|BackOff|Attach"
```
I captured an event: `Failed to pull image: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = registry rate limit` at 09:12:41.
sanjay_infra: I've opened a request to registry team to raise pull concurrency for that pool and to IAM to check service-account token throttles. Also removing the pinned minReplicas policy for that pool (will coordinate with billing owner).
tau_runtime: long-term fixes: 1) add per-pool attach parallelism tuning (config knobs exist but are not surfaced), 2) pre-warm pool based on scheduled windows or predictive ML, 3) improve fallback routing so we can transparently send traffic to a compatible variant during attach storms.
ryan_oncall: action items (short): 
- elena_cs: get customer consent for temporary minReplicas=20 and fallback route (DONE)
- sanjay_infra: remove minReplicas pin and request registry + IAM quota increases (ETA 2h)
- tau_runtime: prepare hosted fallback config and rollback plan (ETA 30m)
- ryan_oncall: monitor metrics and confirm error rate drops after changes (I'll run the traffic replay once minReplicas raised)
elena_cs: forwarding this plan to ACMECorp. They'll stay on the call for updates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [automated] pool update initiated: eu-west-1-prod-dedicated-42 minReplicas 20 by ryan_oncall at 4471240100.
ryan_oncall: I'm seeing success — new pods scheduling and fewer ContainerCreating stalls. Replaying the customer spike now. Early results: 429s down to ~1% from 18%, tail p95 latency improved ~450ms -> 120ms. Will keep watching for registry/IAM errors.
elena_cs: closing loop with customer, will file a post-incident summary once registry/IAM changes confirmed. Thanks team.
